text:
Samantha: Heads-up 11:30am PT blog post + social push for the release tomorrow. Need tiny checklist: final 1-line changelog, docs URL, a single hero stat, canary timing, and webinar RSVP link. Can everyone confirm?

Jason: Canary plan approved. Start 10:15am PT (15m canary), staged ramp to full by 12:00pm PT. Auto-rollback on >5% error or +12% p95 latency. Models: rwd-core/v1.3 and rwd-core/v1.3-quant.

Elaine: Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/v1-3 now published with migration section and SDK snippets. Adding the benchmark PNG now.

Maria: Changelog needed for hero line. Keep it marketing-friendly but accurate.

Jason: Changelog 1-liner: "v1.3 increases steady-state throughput with smarter KV caching and offers a quantized build that lowers inference cost ~2.5x with minimal p95 impact."

Karl: Hero stat: "~2.5x token/sec steady-state uplift vs v1.2 at 512 seq (L4)" PNG uploaded to docs.

Samantha: Webinar logistics: 2pm PT same day, 30m demo pre-record + 30m live Q&A. Speakers: Maria, Jason, Karl. Promo copy draft ready. Need RSVP that tags HubSpot leads with `release_v1_3`.

hubsync-bot: RSVP created: https://redwood.com/rsvp/v1-3 (leads tagged `release_v1_3`, routed to marketing-inbound).

Samantha: Great. Marketing will queue but hold publish until docs link + changelog line + hero PNG are confirmed in this thread.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled 1776550500 (10:15am PT); full rollout scheduled 1776561600 (12:00pm PT). Will post status to #release-war-room.

Jason: Ops note: will monitor SLOs during canary and post a summary after canary ends. If we see deviation we'll advise pause/rollback and ping marketing.

Maria: Thanks 1 will add migration tip to the blog: `pin model=rwd-core/v1.3` and mention Dedicated customers can follow the docs migration guide.

Samantha: Perfect 1 final ask: Elaine, confirm PNG URL in this thread so marketing can embed.

Elaine: PNG URL: https://docs.redwood.com/assets/v1-3/benchmark-hero.png 1 confirmed. ETA for final copy lock: 5pm PT.

Samantha: Awesome 1 we'll hold on publishing until 5pm PT or earlier if you drop the final copy. Thanks everyone!
